title: Sultan: The Saviour
desc: Raja Dutta and his sister Disha move to Kolkata to start afresh. But Disha is oblivious to Raja's past and his intention behind shifting to Kolkata.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tor Naam

desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Jaanbaaz
desc: Bikram, a gangster, works in a coal mafia. Soon, he falls in love with a mysterious woman, whose true identity he is unaware of.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Kaali Aamar Maa
desc: Lakshmi's birth causes her mother's passing, yet Goddess Kali assumes a maternal role.

desc: Worried to see his daughter Rita in low spirits, Mr Chowdhury decides to take her to Dhaka. There, he hires Raju, a responsible young man, whom Rita falls in love with.

title: Paapi
desc: When Harekrishna offers him a large sum of money, Shambu, a criminal, murders Susanta. Subsequently, his sister Chandra commits suicide due to her love for Susanta.
